Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5-Tesla): maximum B1+rms of 3.6 µT; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 2 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode; No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session.
Device configuration during MRI: Therapy OFF.
Scanning at 7 T has not been evaluated; do not scan at field strengths other than those listed.
